journey.name: Wear - Messages and Quick Reply
journey.description:
Verifies reading conversations and answering from the watch: the conversation list, a thread that opens on its newest message, a canned quick reply, a typed reply that is reviewed before it is sent, a reaction, a slow send that shows "Sending…" and a failed send that can be retried.
Run on a round Wear OS emulator with the bench build. Start with the app stopped. Type by tapping the on-screen keys: text injected with "adb shell input text" is shown by the Wear keyboard but never returned to the app (see docs/wear-testing.md). The "slow_actions" scenario holds a send for 15 seconds; "dm_fails" fails every send after 2 seconds.

actions.action: Launch Nubecita on the watch with the bench scenario "default"
Tap Messages
Verify that the list is titled "Messages" and its first conversation is Ana Ruiz, marked unread, with the preview "Perfect, I'll bring coffee."
Verify that the clock at the top of the screen does not overlap the title
Scroll down with the rotary crown until the conversation "Weekend Trip" is in the middle of the screen
Verify that its preview reads "You: I'll bring snacks."
Scroll up to the top of the list and tap the conversation with Ana Ruiz
Verify that the thread shows the newest message, "Perfect, I'll bring coffee.", fully visible, and that a Reply button is visible
Tap Reply
Verify that the reply screen offers "Speak or type" and the quick replies "On my way" and "Sounds good"
Tap "Sounds good"
Verify that the thread is shown again and that the bubble "Sounds good" is fully visible with the status "Sent"
Verify that the Reply button is visible below the new bubble without scrolling
Tap the message "Perfect, I'll bring coffee."
Verify that a choice of reaction emoji is shown
Tap the first emoji
Verify that the thread is shown again and the reaction appears on the message "Perfect, I'll bring coffee."
Scroll down to the Reply button and tap it, then tap "Speak or type"
Verify that the system text input screen is shown with the label "Your reply"
Tap the keyboard choice, type "see you" by tapping the on-screen keys, and tap the keyboard's Send key
Verify that a review screen titled "Your reply" shows the text "See you", a character count, and the buttons Change and Send
Tap Send
Verify that the thread is shown again with the bubble "See you" and the status "Sent"
Swipe right from the left edge of the screen to go back
Verify that the conversation list is shown, not the reply screen or the review screen
Launch Nubecita on the watch with the bench scenario "slow_actions"
Tap Messages, tap the conversation with Ana Ruiz, tap Reply and tap "On my way"
Verify that the bubble "On my way" shows the status "Sending…"
Wait 15 seconds
Verify that the bubble "On my way" shows the status "Sent"
Launch Nubecita on the watch with the bench scenario "dm_fails"
Tap Messages, tap the conversation with Ana Ruiz, tap Reply and tap "Running late"
Wait 3 seconds
Verify that the bubble "Running late" shows "Not sent — tap to retry"
Tap the bubble "Running late"
Verify that the bubble shows "Sending…"
Wait 3 seconds
Verify that the bubble shows "Not sent — tap to retry" again and appears only once in the thread
